stem: Meera stands facing a plane mirror at home and raises her right hand to wave at her reflection. How does her raised hand appear in the mirror image?

options.text: It appears exactly the same, with no change of side.
It appears as the left hand, raised on the opposite side.
It appears upside down at the bottom of the mirror.
It does not appear in the mirror at all.

teacher.key_rationale: In a plane mirror, lateral inversion makes the right hand appear as the left hand on the opposite side of the image; the image is not inverted top-to-bottom and is always formed for an object in front of the mirror.
